text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fan appreciation project was reportedly 
taking place, and I was asked to check in 
on the committee members. And the title of 
that project was...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The "Exciting☆ Win Special Gifts Chosen by 
Popular Horse Girls! Campaign♪".

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am glad the title was deemed accurate. 
For this project, multiple students 
designated by the Academy will each 
prepare one "present."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Currently, the submission of "presents" 
from participants is behind schedule, so I 
am executing the "Reminder Mission."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, issuing "reminders" has been 
judged to require high-level communication 
skills. I am presently deliberating on the 
"strategy" before execution.
choice_data_list: You're really being considerate of them.

You're really being considerate of them, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Affirmative. As an executive committee 
member, I wish to avoid causing 
unnecessary stress to the target subjects.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To prevent generating the "Pressure" 
status effect, is there any method to 
mitigate it...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—! Calculation complete. A "brilliant 
idea" has surfaced. Trainer-san, do you 
have available time right now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I predict that having a three-way 
conversation will reduce the tense 
atmosphere compared to a one-on-one 
situation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, "I request your 
accompaniment." ...Could I ask this of 
you?
choice_data_list: Then strike while the iron is hot!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The first target is Copano Rickey-san. 
Reportedly, she returned straight to the 
dorms today, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bourbon-san and Trainer? Could this qi 
mean... you're here about the present?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Lucky☆! What a fortunate alignment! I just 
bought it and got back!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! It's a Copa-style good luck☆ owl 
figurine!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Received without issue.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for being late! I absolutely had to 
buy it in an auspicious direction, so I 
traveled all the way to the neighboring 
prefecture!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ The effect of an auspicious 
direction gets stronger the further away 
you go from where you normally live, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Finding the right shop was pretty tough~! 
But still! I really wanted whoever wins it 
to be blessed with good luck, so I gave it 
my all!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see... I understand that you invested 
substantial time and effort for the sake 
of the winner's "Luck" stat.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rather than merely gifting an object, you 
infused it with deep "feelings," I 
observe.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Exactly☆! I hope whoever wins your present 
receives great qi too, Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ack! A sudden disruption in the yin and 
yang qi...?! Mmm, I gotta balance it back 
into harmony...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reboot complete—My apologies for earlier. 
I am functional now.
choice_data_list: Um, what about your present, Bourbon...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I was selecting it in the background, 
but selection criteria were absent from 
memory, causing cognitive processing load 
to spike...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Initial target spotted. Condition: 
Resting. —Approaching.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Oh? What is the matter, you 
two...?
choice_data_list: We're here to collect that present!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I'm sorry. It had completely 
slipped my mind...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No problem. The deadline has been 
extended, so there is no issue as long as 
it is retrieved before then.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still... it would be troublesome if I 
forgot again, so I will prepare it right 
away. Please wait here.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Here, this is for you...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I brought a brand-new set from my 
locker. I buy them in bulk, so I have 
plenty.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Verification underway. ...Status: 
"Interest." So this is Suzuka-san's 
personal favorite item...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that reaction is just like when I 
gave one to a fan before.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth... shortly after my 
debut, I gave a horseshoe to a fan once.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't sure what to give, but they 
requested it and were overjoyed, saying 
"It's Suzuka's personal gear!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, whenever an occasion like 
this comes up, I always end up gifting a 
set of horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not particularly knowledgeable 
about anything other than running, but 
this is something I can give with 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what did you pick, Bourbon? 
I'm looking forward to seeing what you 
chose.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...? Did you run out of energy? I—I 
have a strawberry daifuku snack if that 
helps...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reboot complete—My apologies for earlier. 
I am functional now.
choice_data_list: Um, what about your present, Bourbon...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I was selecting it in the background, 
but selection criteria were absent from 
memory, causing cognitive processing load 
to spike...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Upon pausing the process to prioritize 
other tasks, the inactive state persisted 
until it resulted in an unexpected forced 
termination...
choice_data_list: You just forgot about it, didn't you...
You just forgot about it, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status: "Careless"...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, through this reminder mission, a 
substantial amount of sample data has been 
acquired.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
After installing the data, I will promptly 
resume the task: "Select Optimal Present."
